transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
Thanks for seeing me, doctor. I can’t seem to slow down—I’m constantly taking on new projects and working nonstop, like I’m stuck in overdrive.
Have you had any beliefs that others said were unrealistic or not true, or heard or seen things that other people could not? This helps me tell whether this is mania with psychotic symptoms.

My wife and my boss definitely think my plans are unrealistic, but I honestly feel like I’m meant to revolutionize the local solar and smart-home industry because I see solutions other electricians just can't grasp. They'll thank me once they see how big this is, so I know I'm on the right track. As for hearing or seeing things that aren't there, no, nothing like that has ever happened.
Have you ever had a period of at least a week when you felt depressed or lost interest in things, or needed treatment for depression?

No, I’ve never really experienced periods of depression or lost interest in things like that. My main issue lately has been the exact opposite—I feel extremely wired, energetic, and completely unable to slow down.
Have you ever had any past episodes of mania or hypomania, even if you did not feel depressed afterward?
No, this is the very first time I've ever felt like this. Prior to this current stretch starting about seven months ago, I've never had any periods of being this wired, high-energy, or in overdrive.
Has this high-energy, overactive state lasted for at least 1 week continuously, and has it caused major problems at work, with finances, or in your relationships?

Yes, it’s lasted way longer than a week—it’s been intense and continuous for about seven months now. It’s caused huge problems because my boss pulled me off field work due to safety concerns and client complaints, and my wife is furious about the massive credit card debts I've run up. I'm just never really present with the family anymore.
Have you had any hallucinations, or have you held any beliefs so strongly that other people could not possibly convince you they were untrue?

No, I definitely don't see or hear things that aren't there. But I do firmly believe I'm destined to revolutionize solar and smart homes around here because I see solutions other electricians just aren't smart enough to understand. That's why I ignore my wife and boss when they tell me to slow down, because they just can't see the big picture yet.
Have you ever heard voices, seen things that weren’t there, or had beliefs so fixed that no one could possibly convince you they were untrue?
No, I’ve never heard any voices or seen things that aren't actually there. I also don't think I have any unusual or fixed beliefs; my plans and ideas are just logical steps for my future business.
Have you ever had a belief so strong that, even when others clearly proved it wrong, you still could not doubt it at all? Or heard voices or seen things that others could not?
No, I've never had any beliefs that were proven wrong but I still couldn't doubt. And I've definitely never heard voices or seen things that other people couldn't.
During this period, have you been sleeping much less than usual but still felt full of energy the next day?

Yes, absolutely. Most nights I only sleep for two or three hours because my mind is racing with wiring diagrams and business plans, so I just get back up and keep working. I don't feel tired at all—I feel completely wired, energized, and honestly annoyed at the idea of wasting time sleeping.

During this period, have you had any beliefs that were clearly untrue or far beyond what’s realistic, even if no one could convince you otherwise? Or have you heard or seen things that other people could not?

No, I haven't heard or seen things that others couldn't, and I don't have any beliefs that are completely detached from reality. I just have extremely strong confidence in my business plans and what I'm trying to build.

Have you ever had a period during this episode when you felt so unusually important or powerful that it was clearly out of touch with reality, or had others say your beliefs were completely impossible to reason with?

I don't think it's out of touch with reality at all, but I do feel destined to revolutionize how people use solar and smart homes because I see solutions other electricians aren't smart enough to grasp. My boss and wife have both told me to slow down and think I'm being unrealistic, but I ignore them because I'm absolutely certain they will thank me once they see how massive and successful these plans are.
Have you ever had a period during this episode when you felt so certain of something that no one could convince you otherwise, even if it was clearly impossible or far beyond reality?

I am absolutely certain that I'm destined to revolutionize how people use solar power and smart homes because I see solutions other electricians just aren't smart enough to understand. That is why I ignore my wife and boss when they tell me to slow down. I fully believe they will thank me once they see how massive this success is going to be.
Have you ever heard voices, seen things that weren’t there, or had beliefs so fixed and clearly untrue that no one could convince you otherwise?
No, I've never heard any voices or seen things that weren't actually there. I also don't have any completely unrealistic or untrue beliefs; my plans are just ambitious business ideas.

Have you ever had any beliefs during this episode that were clearly impossible or completely out of touch with reality, even when others tried to prove you wrong? Or heard voices or seen things that other people could not?

No, I've never heard voices or seen things that aren't there, and I don't have any impossible beliefs. While I have very big plans for my solar business and feel highly capable of pulling them off, I haven't experienced anything out of touch with reality like that.
Have you been doing any unusually risky things during this period, like spending sprees, reckless driving, unsafe sex, or making major impulsive decisions?

Yes, I've made some major impulsive financial decisions, like ordering expensive tools and solar inventory on credit for a business that doesn't actually exist yet. This has run up massive debts and strained our finances, which has made my wife absolutely furious. At the time, though, I felt it was completely justified because of the big plans I have.
During this episode, have you ever heard voices, seen things other people could not, or had beliefs so fixed and clearly untrue that no one could convince you otherwise?
No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I've never heard voices, seen things that weren't there, or had any beliefs that were completely out of touch with reality.
